# Share links for `core_validation::link_corpus_validates_against_real_cores`:
# each one is parsed, built for every core that can run it and checked by the
# staged xray / sing-box. A link no core can run must be refused with the
# reason (`core_conflict`). One link per line; lines starting with `#` and blank
# lines are skipped. Hosts, ids and keys are anonymised; keys are well-formed
# so the cores accept them.
